stable.headline: 26 new library parts, Align parts, Transform on several parts at once, and a search you can move.
notes: 26 new library parts on two new shelves: 112 parts in all.
Align parts: line parts up or spread them evenly.
The Transform panel works on several parts at once.
Move the search by its icon. It remembers where you put it.
A part search that forgives a typo.
Bake geo turns a library shape into an ordinary mesh.
The Edit mesh tools are a bar at the right of the view, and Box pick is live.
